passage.label: May hands Abu Lahab perish may he perish; not avail wealth gained; enter Fire flaming

arabicExcerpts.text: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

mainSubject.label: Abu Lahab's hands condemned to perish along with himself; his wealth and gains will not avail him as he enters a flaming Fire

subordinateSubjects.label: The hands of Abu Lahab condemned to perish, and may he himself perish
His wealth and what he gained will not avail him
He will enter a Fire that flames

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Named individual cursed with total ruin despite wealth and gains

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Wealth and worldly acquisition declared futile against divine condemnation

relationships.label: Flaming Fire specified as the destination matching the named transgression

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the flaming-Fire entry verdict (3) before the wife-description opens (4); P2 covers the two-verse closing portrait of the firewood-carrier with her palm-fibre rope.
